about: The sources Ouro images (registry/ouro/images/images.ts) makes site/public/showcase/ from: node registry/ouro/images/images.ts site/showcase --out site/public/showcase --widths 640,960,1280,1920 --base /showcase/
method: Playwright Chromium, 1280x900 viewport at 2x, prefers-color-scheme light and dark, scrolled 500px, cropped to the top 690 CSS px and kept at full resolution (2560 wide) as WebP quality 90
why: Recaptured at full resolution so the home page's row, 1200 CSS px wide on a laptop, draws from enough pixels on a 2x screen; the earlier capture, copied from ourostack/ouroboros-website@3752010, was resized to 1600 wide.
notes: Unedited screenshots of the live Spoonjoy app with its X-ray overlay, which outlines and names each Ouro HX component on the page.

phone.method: Playwright Chromium, 390x844 viewport at 2x as a touch phone, prefers-color-scheme light and dark, scrolled to 330 CSS px above the recipe's heading, cropped to y 92-1416 device px (780x1324) and saved as WebP quality 90
phone.why: On a phone the wide capture shrank to a strip too small to read; the home page shows this one below 640px.
